title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page does not belong to the divided-power De Rham notes around it. It is page 122 of a typescript of SGA 7 I, Exposé IX (Grothendieck, 'Modèles de Néron et monodromie'), §10.2. It was evidently filed among the cote 136 manuscripts; the previous and next pages are the handwritten De Rham / divided-power material.

Setting: K is the fraction field of a discrete valuation ring, and A_K is an abelian variety over K with semi-stable reduction. A'_K is its dual. M and M' are the (character-type) lattices attached to the toric parts of the special fibres of the Néron models of A_K and A'_K. u_ℓ^{A_K} : M_ℓ ⊗ M'_ℓ → Z_ℓ is the ℓ-adic monodromy pairing (Grothendieck's monodromy pairing).

(10.2.2) is the symmetry statement: the pairing for A'_K equals the pairing for A_K composed with the swap s.

Reformulation via a polarization: a polarization ξ gives ξ~ : A_K → A'_K, which induces ξ_t : M → M' on the toric parts. One then forms φ^t_{ξ,ℓ}(x,y) = u_ℓ(x, ξ_t(y)) on M_ℓ. Using the anticommutativity of the Weil-type pairings φ_ξ (SGA 7 VIII 2.2.11), (10.2.2) becomes the statement that this bilinear form is symmetric (10.2.5).

The text adds three remarks:
- (10.2.5) holds for any ξ in the Néron–Severi group.
- It is equivalent to (10.2.2) only when ξ is non-degenerate, i.e. an isogeny.
- For a polarization it is sharpened later, in 10.4 b): the positivity/definiteness of the monodromy form.

The page then begins a third interpretation via a biextension (divisorial correspondence) ξ on a pair (A_K, Ā_K), giving A_K → Ā'_K. Overall this serves the theory of monodromy of abelian varieties with semi-stable reduction (ℓ-adic Picard–Lefschetz for abelian varieties).
errors: No mathematical errors visible. One small point: depending on whether M denotes characters or cocharacters of the torus, the variance of ξ_t : M → M' should be checked against SGA 7 IX §2; on the published convention it is consistent.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a typescript page of the published SGA 7 Exposé IX, misfiled among the De Rham notes. Its content is published and credited to Grothendieck.
transcription_corrections: The page is a typed page from SGA 7 I, Exp. IX (page 122, chapter IX), not part of the handwritten divided-power De Rham notes. '440' is an archival foliation number.
In (10.2.2), 's' denotes the swap (symmetry) of factors, i.e. u^{A'} = u^{A} ∘ s.
Subscripts are written inconsistently in the typescript: φ^t_{ξℓ} and φ^t_{ξ,ℓ} denote the same form.
